text:
sylvie_procure: apex just pinged, 14 H100s inbound. they flagged 12 units as "manifest mismatch" with APAC customs. need quick triage and cost options.

matt_ops: current apac pools at 82% util. if those 12 stay held we'll hit throughput breach for a few nightly batch jobs. can we borrow eu for short term?

ashley_pm: prefer to avoid cross-region perf hits. cost/leadtime options?

juan_vendor: options from our side:
- standard sea (6-8w) no extra freight, but customs hold risk remains
- air expedite (2-3d transit) + freight premium $2.5k/unit + per-shipment priority fee $4.2k
- split: prioritize 8 critical units by air, rest sea -> saves ~40% vs full air
we can re-file manifest same-day if you pay broker expedite ~$900. if manifest error is vendor-origin we'll refund broker fee.

noah_logistics: confirmed: refile + broker expedite clears holds in 24h typically. we can also do a depot swap: stage 8 loaner units from local depot to cover critical capacity while vendor resolves customs. depot swap cost ~= $650 per unit (handling + short-term insurance).

matt_ops: swapping loaners sounds lower cost and faster than air if depot has stock. what's apac depot inventory?

sylvie_procure: checking...

noah_logistics: APAC depot snapshot: 6 hot-spare H100s available in SIN depot, 3 in SYD, total 9. so we can cover 8 immediately via depot swap but need to route replacements back when vendor clears.

ashley_pm: build decision tree:
- Option A (split air 8): minimize SLO risk, cost estimate (air freight + fees + broker) ~ $23k extra
- Option B (depot swap 8): near-zero transit time, handling $5.2k total, but requires later replacement from vendor sea shipment and coordination for return AWB
- Option C (full air): expensive ~$40k but fastest for full top-up
Which aligns with finance appetite?

sylvie_procure: i'll push quick numbers to finance. Juan, please confirm you'll reissue manifest and accept liability if manifest error is on your side. we need that in writing.

juan_vendor: confirmed in thread: we'll re-issue manifest now and accept reimbursement of broker fee if the mismatch originated from our docs. pushing manifest_v2 to RMA ticket.

rma_bot: RMA ticket RMA-5513 created. status: customs_hold. attachments: manifest_v2.pdf.

matt_ops: my vote: depot swap for 8 (Option B) to eliminate immediate SLO risk, authorize broker expedite for the remaining held units (pay only if needed). we throttle non-critical batch concurrency for 48h.

ashley_pm: agree. prepare customer comms if any latency blips. we'll schedule a short retro if handoffs go odd.

noah_logistics: initiating depot swap now. opening return placeholder for inbound sea shipments. ETA for swap: 6-8h for SIN->cluster handoff. creating AWB placeholder AWB-AXS-11900 for later returns.

juan_vendor: manifest_v2 uploaded to RMA-5513 and cc'd broker. will confirm reimbursement policy in PO amendment.

sylvie_procure: finance pre-approved up to $6k for handling and depot ops. i'll confirm formal PO amendment requesting vendor sign-off on manifest liability and broker reimbursement.

rma_bot: RMA-5513 update: manifest_v2 processed, broker_paid_flag: false, carrier_awb: pending, next_status: awaiting_broker_confirmation.

matt_ops: thanks team. i'll implement the 48h concurrency throttle and monitor SLOs. leave thread open until RMA clears and depot replacements are staged back.
